records.subject: Nb5+ substitution in CaSiO3
records.quote: A comprehensive density functional theory (DFT) analysis was carried out on pristine and Nb-substituted CaSiO3 to determine how Nb incorporation modifies the structural, electronic, optical, thermoelectric, mechanical, magnetic, and piezoelectric responses of the host lattice.
context_quotes: Birch-Murnaghan fits indicate that Nb5+ substitution expands the equilibrium volume to 3143.16 and 3068.35 bohr3 at 12.5% and 25% Nb, respectively, while reducing the bulk modulus, consistent with enhanced compressibility driven by the larger Nb5+ ionic radius and associated oxygensublattice relaxation.

records.subject: Pristine CaSiO3
records.object: Strong deep-UV absorption, onset near 6 eV
records.quote: A comprehensive density functional theory (DFT) analysis was carried out on pristine and Nb-substituted CaSiO3 to determine how Nb incorporation modifies the structural, electronic, optical, thermoelectric, mechanical, magnetic, and piezoelectric responses of the host lattice.
context_quotes: Optical responses follow this evolution: pristine CaSiO3 displays strong deep-UV absorption with an onset near 6 eV, whereas Nb doping suppresses interband oscillator strength, redistributes spectral weight, and produces smoother epsilon 2 (w), a (w), k (w), a (w), and R (w) across 0-14 eV; the 25% alloy further exhibits an enhanced low-energy refractive index and intensified plasmonic loss features around 10-12 eV.
